events.info: Acclaimed TV late night show host, admired stand-up comedian, best-selling children's book author, much-in-demand corporate speaker, TV and movie voice-over artist, pioneering car builder and mechanic, and philanthropist... Jay Leno is widely characterized as "the hardest working man in show business." Jay Leno's late night television ratings domination included two decades as the host of the #1-rated "The Tonight Show with Jay Leno" - after the first two years Jay Leno never lost a single ratings year in which he served as host. Leno currently produces and is host of JAY LENOS GARAGE YOUTUBE CHANNEL, which has an international following and has garnered several Emmy Awards and nominations for Outstanding Special Class - Short-Format Nonfiction Programs.
events.pleaseNote: No refunds or exchanges. Event date and time subject to change. All ages are required to have a ticket for this event. The Tennessee Theatre is not responsible for any tickets that are lost, stolen, or purchased through third party websites. Free parking available on weekends and after 6pm on weekdays in the State Street Garage behind the Theatre. For the safety of all patrons, all persons and items entering the Theatre are subject to screening by security officers and metal detectors. The magic shines brighter than ever as beloved stories from Zootopia 2, Tangled, Beauty and the Beast, Toy Story, and Monsters, Inc. unfold in spectacular fashion, bringing Hollywood inspired glamour to the ice. events.name: UT Opera Theatre presents "The Crucible"
events.info: A gripping return to Salem?s charged world of accusation and conscience, centering on John and Elizabeth Proctor?s moral stand. This operatic interpretation of Arthur Miller's timely play fuses lyrical intensity with sharp, speech-driven drama. An American classic that earned the Pulitzer Prize for Music, UTOT is thrilled to revisit this powerful work, last seen on our stage in 2009 and 2017, performed by two talented casts and an orchestra of University of Tennessee Opera Theatre students.

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The University of Tennessee Athletic Ticket Office is open Monday-Friday / 8:30 a.m. - 5:00 p.m. ET and located at 1600 Phillip Fulmer Way in Thompson-Boling Arena. The Neyland Stadium Box Office at Gate 21 opens four (4) hours prior to kick-off and remains open until the 5-minute point of the 2nd quarter. For noon games, the Neyland Stadium Box Office at Gate 21 will open 3 hours prior to kick-off. A satellite location at Gate 23 opens 2.5 hours before kick-off and closes early in the 1st quarter.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: The Neyland Stadium box office is cashless, but accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, Apple Pay and Google Pay.

venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: For athletic events, accessible seating is based on availability and accessible options are available on Ticketmaster. For further questions please call 865-656-1200.

generalInfo.generalRule: Everyone regardless of age must have a ticket. All articles, including purses are subject to search. NO REFUNDS/EXCHANGES. Ticket obtained outside of the box office and Ticketmaster may not be honored. For prohibited items and event day information, please visit UTSports Gameday Central.

events.info: Lights, Camera, Magic! Step into the spotlight as Mickey, Minnie, Donald, Daisy, and Goofy welcome you to a star studded Disney On Ice gala experience. Add a hint of re-carpet flair as you get ready for an unforgettable evening with your favorite Disney friends. The magic shines brighter than ever as beloved stories from Zootopia 2, Tangled, Beauty and the Beast, Toy Story, and Monsters, Inc. unfold in spectacular fashion, bringing Hollywood inspired glamour to the ice. Be among the honored guest as Stitch introduces Angel for her shimmering on ice debut, and prepare for scene stealing entrance by Disney Villains that will keep you on the edge of your seat. When the spotlight turns to celebrate you, It's your moment to bask in the glitz, excitement, and enchantment of Disney On Ice presents Spotlight Magic! *Note: Costumes not permitted for guest 14 years & older.
events.pleaseNote: All guest age 2 & older are required to have a ticket. Note: No Costumes for guests 14 & older. Monitor the venue website for venue policies, including health and safety protocols, which are subject to change. All ticket are subject to availability. Prices are subject to change. Visit DisneyOnIce.com for more event info and ticket Terms and Conditions. boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Monday-Friday 10:00am-3:00pm. Day of event - Will Call is available 1 hour prior to the start of performance
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Tennessee Theatre is a digital ticketing venue. The Box Office will be available 1 hour prior to performance to assist with ticketing needs.

venues.parkingDetail: Free parking is available for most night and weekend performances at the State Street garage located behind the theater, as well as the nearby Locust Street and Market Square garages. Additional parking lots and on-street parking are located nearby. For performances during regular business hours, parking is available in all of these areas for a fee. Parking fees vary from lot to lot. Please allow ample time to park.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: The venue has ADA seating in various locations. Please call venue Box Office for these. Venue has Elevators, and ADA Facilities, ADA Parking, ADA ramps and Entrance. For more info call 865-684-1200 ext. 2.

generalInfo.generalRule: Cameras, camera phones, audio, video and digital recorders, paging devices, and cell phones may not be permitted in the theatres based on the artists' policies. Guests using prohibited items may be ejected without refund.
generalInfo.childRule: All attendees, regardless of age, are required to hold a ticket. This applies to children who may sit on an adult's lap for the majority or entirety of a performance. For question, please contact the Box Office.
